Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State as well as learned counsel for the complainant/opposite party no.2, who has appeared suo motu.
2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Complaint Case No.1033 of 2023 instituted under Sections 323,498A and 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the D.P. Act.
4. It has been jointly prayed that the matter be referred for mediation as there is every chance of amicable settlement between the parties.
